description: A two-tiered dish rack designed for efficient drying and organization of kitchenware. The top tier features vertical slots for plates, holding them upright to facilitate water drainage. The bottom tier offers a larger, flatter surface, ideal for cups, bowls, and other larger items. The rack is constructed from a sturdy metal frame with a sleek black finish, providing durability and a modern aesthetic. Its open design allows for ample airflow, promoting faster drying and preventing moisture buildup. The rack is compact yet spacious, suitable for most standard kitchen countertops.
